== Original post ==

'''Order To Engage in space'''
* '''Author:''' Per "Foppalandet" Wahlgren
* '''Published:''' January 10, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' boosted X-wing's attacks in space.

=== Strategy ===

You should always start with Yarna d'al' Gargan so you won't have to suffer from monnoks. Sometimes it's hard to know if you want to flip the objective or not. It might get scary if the opponent has a security precations. The 2 Order To Engage can mess up any imperial fleet. Just follow his starships everywhere and make him take the hard choice of battling your greater forces or losing 3 force. 3 force hurts bad. Order To Engage can also be used in a satisfying way in a combo with Rebel Barrier. I think the pair of kessel's are needed because a force drain of 3 every turn should be painful for the opponent. Just don't deploy kessel too early in the game, giving the opponent extra force-generation. Maybe this deck needs another Ultimatum for protection against Odds. But if you really should need ultimatum, use Tunnel Vision. Cloud City works fine as a sanctuary from those big imperial destroyers. Just remember to watch out for Lateral Damage if you encounter an imperial space-deck…
